title: The Horde
description: Forty-one people, one mill, and a militia of nine men who are also the harvest - that's Mill Brook, and a goblin-and-orc warband three times the militia's number is two days out on the eastern road. Elder Bram couldn't pay the Company's full rate if he sold the mill itself, so this contract runs on a standing arrangement with Dalhurst's grain buyers, who lose their winter flour if Mill Brook burns. Steele is sending the full Company. Nine militiamen and forty-one people are not going to hold this alone.

objectives.description: Organize Mill Brook's defenses before the warband arrives
Repel the first wave of goblin scouts off the mill road
Hold the line against the orc warriors behind them
Destroy the siege engines before they reach the mill
Break the warchief and scatter what's left of the horde
Report to Steele that Mill Brook still stands

notes: Reuses millbrook_bandits.json / millbrook_elder.json facts verbatim per Step 3 - forty-one people, one mill, a nine-man militia who are also the harvest, Elder Bram. This is the same Mill Brook, not a duplicate. Threat: a warband three times the militia's size, two days out. Giver motive: the contract is invented as a standing Dalhurst grain-buyer arrangement (no bible basis, local colour) since Mill Brook itself could never afford Company rates - this keeps Bram's established poverty intact rather than contradicting it. Consequence: no world flag records Mill Brook's survival here; a later pass could set one for millbrook_bandits/millbrook_elder to reference.
